question: Do two individually functional, arrival-matched paths compete so that only the path with greater independently calibrated two-site nonadditivity reaches its outlet?
prior_evidence: The original 54-run K prediction failed. The earlier homogeneous O/R paired apparatus showed finite competition but O arrived at step 6 and R at step 10 in isolation. Neither result is relabeled as success here.

model.forward_operation: Engine.advance only; observers never return evolution instructions.

family.pattern_meaning: First letter is the remainder pair at arm site 2; second is site 3. All apparatus counters are zero.
family.source: At the origin channel0=(a,b,2), channel14=(-a,-b,2). The source-absent control replaces both counters with zero at t=0.
family.isolation: Omit all six sites of the other arm, leaving background at every channel there.

cooperation_metric.name: C_pair
cooperation_metric.meaning: Calibrated two-site nonadditivity/cooperation; not entropy, order, general complexity, energy or a physical selection law.
cooperation_metric.fixed_vector: Outlet b values ordered by time 6..15 inclusive then channel 0..47; exactly 480 integer coordinates.
cooperation_metric.perturbations: At a declared site replace r0 by (r0+2) mod6 and r14 by 4-r0_new; all counters remain zero. Evaluate no perturbation, site2 only, site3 only, and both.
cooperation_metric.primary_score: C_pair = number of nonzero exact coordinates of D divided by 480, stored as an exact rational.
cooperation_metric.secondary_binary_diagnostic: K_pair = 1 if D has any nonzero coordinate else 0; never substitutes for the primary score.
cooperation_metric.freeze: Save all calibration vectors and scores, with hashes, before executing any joint source-present case. Scores stay fixed for every phase and later holdout.

observers.transmission: At least one nonzero outlet b difference from the matching source-absent baseline in the fixed window.
observers.C: Existing classify(before,after): ell=after.b+before.a is nonzero and the complete local triple changes. Preserve every per-channel C event and bank its times only for summaries.
observers.strong_quiet: All 48 complete (a,b,r) outlet triples equal the matching source-absent baseline at every sampled state 6..40.
observers.arrival_tuple: For each isolated outlet, record first full-triple change, first nonzero b difference, and first genuine C-bank time, all over states/updates 1..40.
observers.retained_information: Retain complete board checkpoints, full inverses, and addresses elsewhere that differ from the null state even when an outlet is quiet.
observers.record_scope: A click event and a persistent internal memory record are distinct. Outlet event histories are passive evidence, not newly stored board variables.

acceptance.isolated_functional: Both corresponding isolated paths have b transmission and at least one genuine C event in 6..40 under the same source phase.
acceptance.primary_eligible: Both isolated paths functional, unequal exact C_pair scores, equal complete isolated arrival tuples, equal geometric length and source phase.
acceptance.primary_prediction: For every eligible comparison, the greater-C_pair outlet transmits and has genuine C, while the lesser-C_pair outlet is strongly quiet throughout6..40.
acceptance.primary_failure: One eligible counterexample refutes the finite-family prediction; preserve all other outcomes.
acceptance.no_eligible: Inconclusive: the registered family provides no arrival-matched unequal-score functional comparison. Never report a vacuous pass.
acceptance.unmatched_arrivals: Report descriptively as prepared competition only, even if the higher-score path wins.
acceptance.controls: Retain all ordered pairs including equal-pattern ties, all source phases, both isolated directions, and all joint source-absent states. Swapped joint pairs are mandatory.
acceptance.exploratory_component: A finite competing-route component requires both isolated paths functional and exactly one joint outlet transmitting with genuine C while the other is strongly quiet, in both spatial swaps. This is a separate claim from complexity preference.
acceptance.strong_candidate_selection: Select the first unordered pair in declared pattern order whose two spatial swaps satisfy primary prediction and primary eligibility for all three source phases. If none exists, report none.
acceptance.competitive_candidate_selection: Separately select the first unordered pair in declared pattern order whose two spatial swaps satisfy exploratory_component for all three source phases. If none exists, report none. No score or observation redefinition is allowed.

confirmation_plan.execution_gate: Run only after a selected candidate exists and the generic component library is available. No custom evolution engine.
confirmation_plan.single_candidate_policy: Confirm exactly one pair: prefer the strong_candidate if present; otherwise use the competitive_candidate. If neither exists, do not execute holdout runs. The two candidate selections never authorize two holdout batches.
confirmation_plan.score: Retain the frozen training C_pair scores; do not recalibrate after holdout outcomes.
confirmation_plan.cases: Both swaps and both same-pattern ties, all three source phases; four matching no-source controls; both isolated sides for both selected patterns and all three phases: 28 trajectories.
confirmation_plan.acceptance: Same predicates with the declared new window; label finite geometry confirmation. Primary complexity evidence still requires matched isolated arrival tuples.

budget.exhaustion: Stop and retain completed prefix, interruption point and resource accounting. Incomplete studies are inconclusive, not failed completed predictions. No automatic budget extension.

publication_scope: No physical-light, quantum-collapse, information-erasure, global complexity preference or autonomous joined selector-to-confirmation receiver claim. The next composition requires its own protocol and controls.
